name: Savitri Temple, Pushkar
summary: Hilltop Savitri Mandir overlooking Pushkar — paired with the Brahma temple legend.
famousFor: Savitri who cursed Brahma · hill shrine above Pushkar
mythology: After the Pushkar yajna quarrel, Savitri withdrew to Ratnagiri. Pilgrims climb to her temple for the vista of the lake and to remember that even the creator’s story includes a wife’s dignity and a curse that shaped worship.
